name: You and your agent fill one cart
description: Lines the shopper adds and lines the agent adds share one cart and one total; only the agent's are marked.

planSteps.description: Open /p/nalgene-740315 on this site and click 'Add to cart'
Click the 'Your agent' button at the bottom right of the page
Click the task 'Add two of the cheapest wide-mouth bottles' and wait for its reply
Verify 'Tool calls' shows Search catalog, then Add to cart, then View cart
Verify the reply says 'Added 2 × 32oz Wide Mouth Ultralite Bottle at $11.99 each.' and gives the cart total '$36.57'
Verify the header cart button shows 3
Verify the '32oz Wide Mouth Ultralite Bottle' line has quantity 2 and is marked 'Added by your agent'
Verify the '8oz Storage Jar – Blue Lid' line is not marked 'Added by your agent'
Verify Items '$28.17', Shipping '$6.99', Service fee (5%) '$1.41' and Total '$36.57'
